notes: Traps, priority order: (1) the decoder function name is RANDOMIZED per page load — hardcoding it fails every channel (the first probe died exactly this way); the assembly regexes are TEMPLATES built from the $fn capture. (2) NEVER fetch the apex cdnlivetv.tv player route — it rate-limits brutally (~500 req/hour walls the IP for hours; the whole US titan tier was lost to a 429 wall on 2026-08-28). The IDENTICAL page on api.cdnlivetv.tv is unthrottled and mints the same 4h tokens — the rewrite step is load-bearing, not cosmetic. (3) Fragments are URLSAFE base64 ( - and _ ), padded to %4 before decode. (4) Playable with a plain browser UA, no Referer. (5) Tokens are 4h and NOT IP-bound — a feed-minted URL plays anywhere until it ages out; on-box re-mint matters only when the feed is staler than the token.
